summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests Daromun, given into the tumor before surgery, in adults with stage IIIB, IIIC, or IIID melanoma that can be surgically removed. Daromun is given as intratumoral injections once weekly for up to 4 weeks, followed by surgery within a maximum of 4 weeks and then adjuvant therapy at the investigator's discretion. The main outcome stated is recurrence-free survival (RFS), compared with surgery and adjuvant therapy alone.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 evalúa Daromun, administrado dentro del tumor antes de la cirugía, en adultos con melanoma en estadio IIIB, IIIC o IIID que puede extirparse quirúrgicamente. Daromun se administra como inyecciones intratumorales una vez por semana durante hasta 4 semanas, seguidas de cirugía en un máximo de 4 semanas y de terapia adyuvante a criterio del investigador. El resultado principal indicado es la supervivencia libre de recurrencia (RFS, por sus siglas en inglés), comparada con cirugía y terapia adyuvante solas.
who_for: Stage IIIB, IIIC, or IIID melanoma that can be fully surgically removed.
At least one injectable skin, under-skin, or lymph node lesion of 10 mm or more, or several injectable lesions adding up to 10 mm or more.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 1 or lower.
Blood count, liver, and kidney test results within the limits set in the record.
not_for: Heart attack or unstable angina within the past year, or heart insufficiency above NYHA grade II.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or lower, or clinically significant heart test abnormalities.
Known allergy to IL2, TNF, or other components of the product.
